fields.summary_ko.0: Berkshire Hathaway retains approximately $18.6 billion in Chevron CVX holdings after selling roughly 35% of its stake (4.3% of market cap, 5% of portfolio) – new CEO Greg Abel demonstrates intent to maintain energy market exposure.
fields.summary_ko.1: Chevron stock rallied +40% over 12 months, with projected 2025–2028 revenue and EPS CAGR of 5% and 26% respectively – at oil price of $95 and breakeven of $50, ample dividend capacity supports 39 consecutive years of dividend increases.
